text: To my beautiful granddaughter. From the moment I first held you in my arms, I knew that my
life would never be the same. I am so proud to have you as my granddaughter and witness
the incredible person you are becoming. I squeezed this bracelet really tight and filled
it with my love, hope, wishes, and light. It's a reminder that no matter where life takes
you, you will always have a piece of my heart with you. I love you forever and always.
